available.quote: The board may waive the examination requirement and license by credentials if the physician, osteopath, or podiatry applicant meets the requirements of AS 08.64.200, 08.64.205, or 08.64.209, submits proof of continued competence as required by regulation, pays the required fee, and has an active license from a board of medical examiners established under the laws of a state or territory of the United States or a province or territory of Canada issued after thorough examination

requirements.value: Active license from another state/territory/province issued after thorough examination, or passed examination as specified by board; must meet all other requirements of AS 08.64.200, 08.64.205, or 08.64.209
requirements.quote: an active license from a board of medical examiners established under the laws of a state or territory of the United States or a province or territory of Canada issued after thorough examination; or passed an examination as specified by the board in regulations

title_protection.quote: to use or publicly display a title in connection with a person's name including "doctor of medicine," "physician," "M.D.," or "doctor of osteopathic medicine" or "D.O." or a specialist designation including "surgeon," "dermatologist," or a similar title in such a manner as to show that the person is willing or qualified to diagnose or treat the sick or injured

scope_protection.quote: A person may not practice medicine, podiatry, or osteopathy in the state unless the person is licensed under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Secured a license through deceit, fraud, or intentional misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: secured a license through deceit, fraud, or intentional misrepresentation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in deceit, fraud, or intentional misrepresentation while providing professional services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engaged in deceit, fraud, or intentional misrepresentation while providing professional services or engaging in professional activities

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertised professional services in a false or misleading manner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: advertised professional services in a false or misleading manner

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of a class A or unclassified felony, or class B/C felony substantially related to qualifications or duties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has been convicted, including conviction based on a guilty plea or plea of nolo contendere, of a class A or unclassified felony or a crime in another jurisdiction with elements similar to a class A or unclassified felony in this jurisdiction; a class B or class C felony or a crime in another jurisdiction with elements similar to a class B or class C felony in this jurisdiction if the felony or other crime is substantially related to the qualifications, functions, or duties of the licensee; or a crime involving the unlawful procurement, sale, prescription, or dispensing of drugs

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procured, sold, prescribed, or dispensed drugs in violation of law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has procured, sold, prescribed, or dispensed drugs in violation of a law regardless of whether there has been a criminal action or harm to the patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentionally or negligently permitted patient care by supervised persons that does not conform to minimum professional standards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: intentionally or negligently permitted the performance of patient care by persons under the licensee's supervision that does not conform to minimum professional standards even if the patient was not injured

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to comply with the chapter, regulations, or board orders
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failed to comply with this chapter, a regulation adopted under this chapter, or an order of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Demonstrated professional incompetence, gross negligence, or repeated negligent conduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: professional incompetence, gross negligence, or repeated negligent conduct

disciplinary_grounds.description: Addiction to, severe dependency on, or habitual overuse of alcohol or other drugs that impairs ability to practice safely
disciplinary_grounds.quote: addiction to, severe dependency on, or habitual overuse of alcohol or other drugs that impairs the licensee's ability to practice safely

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unfitness because of physical or mental disability
disciplinary_grounds.quote: unfitness because of physical or mental disability

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in sexual misconduct or lewd/immoral conduct in connection with professional services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engaged in unprofessional conduct, in sexual misconduct, or in lewd or immoral conduct in connection with the delivery of professional services to patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated any code of ethics adopted by regulation by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has violated any code of ethics adopted by regulation by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Denied care or treatment to a patient solely because patient refused to agree to arbitration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has denied care or treatment to a patient or person seeking assistance from the physician if the only reason for the denial is the failure or refusal of the patient to agree to arbitrate

disciplinary_grounds.description: Had license denied, suspended, revoked, or placed on probation in another jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has had a license or certificate to practice medicine in another state or territory of the United States, or a province or territory of Canada, denied, suspended, revoked, surrendered while under investigation for an alleged violation, restricted, limited, conditioned, or placed on probation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribed or dispensed an opioid in excess of the maximum dosage authorized
disciplinary_grounds.quote: prescribed or dispensed an opioid in excess of the maximum dosage authorized under AS 08.64.363

definition_quote.value: for a fee, donation or other consideration, to diagnose, treat, operate on, prescribe for, or administer to, any human ailment, blemish, deformity, disease, disfigurement, disorder, injury, or other mental or physical condition; or to attempt to perform or represent that a person is authorized to perform any of the acts set out in this subparagraph; to use or publicly display a title in connection with a person's name including "doctor of medicine," "physician," "M.D.," or "doctor of osteopathic medicine" or "D.O." or a specialist designation including "surgeon," "dermatologist," or a similar title in such a manner as to show that the person is willing or qualified to diagnose or treat the sick or injured
definition_quote.quote: "practice of medicine" or "practice of osteopathy" means: (A) for a fee, donation or other consideration, to diagnose, treat, operate on, prescribe for, or administer to, any human ailment, blemish, deformity, disease, disfigurement, disorder, injury, or other mental or physical condition; or to attempt to perform or represent that a person is authorized to perform any of the acts set out in this subparagraph; (B) to use or publicly display a title in connection with a person's name including "doctor of medicine," "physician," "M.D.," or "doctor of osteopathic medicine" or "D.O." or a specialist designation including "surgeon," "dermatologist," or a similar title in such a manner as to show that the person is willing or qualified to diagnose or treat the sick or injured

methods_authorized.quote: to diagnose, treat, operate on, prescribe for, or administer to, any human ailment, blemish, deformity, disease, disfigurement, disorder, injury, or other mental or physical condition

drug_authority.value: May prescribe, dispense, and administer prescription drugs and controlled substances subject to state and federal law and opioid dosage limits
drug_authority.quote: A physician, podiatrist, osteopath, or physician assistant licensed under AS 08.64 may prescribe, dispense, or administer through telehealth under this section a prescription for a controlled substance listed in AS 11.71.140 - 11.71.190 if the physician, podiatrist, osteopath, or physician assistant complies with state and federal law governing the prescription, dispensing, or administering of a controlled substance

license_status_types.quote: A licensee who does not practice in the state may hold an inactive license. A person who practices in the state, however infrequently, shall hold an active license... On retiring from practice and payment of an appropriate one-time fee, a licensee in good standing with the board may apply for the conversion of an active or inactive license to a retired status license

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must complete three years of postgraduate training (or other requirements establishing proof of competency as determined by the board), pass examinations as specified by the board, and meet all other requirements including pain management and opioid use and addiction education
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: Applicants who are graduates of medical colleges not accredited by the Association of American Medical Colleges and the Council on Medical Education of the American Medical Association shall meet the requirements of AS 08.64.200(a)(3) - (5) and 08.64.255; have successfully completed three years of postgraduate training... or other requirements establishing proof of competency and professional qualifications as the board considers necessary to ensure the continued protection of the public adopted at the discretion of the board by regulation, including education in pain management and opioid use and addiction

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: two years if the applicant graduated from medical school on or after January 1, 1995, as evidenced by a certificate of completion of the first year of postgraduate training from the facility where the applicant completed the first year of internship or residency and a certificate of successful completion of one additional year of postgraduate training at a recognized hospital

pain_management_education_required.quote: receive education in pain management and opioid use and addiction, unless the applicant has demonstrated to the satisfaction of the board that the applicant does not currently hold a valid federal Drug Enforcement Administration registration number

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: Initial prescriptions for opioids limited to seven-day supply for adults and minors for outpatient use, with exceptions for acute medical conditions, chronic pain management, cancer pain, palliative care, logistical/travel barriers, and substance abuse treatment
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: A licensee may not issue an initial prescription for an opioid that exceeds a seven-day supply to an adult patient for outpatient use; a prescription for an opioid that exceeds a seven-day supply to a minor... Notwithstanding (a) of this section, a licensee may issue a prescription for an opioid that exceeds a seven-day supply to an adult or minor patient if, in the professional medical judgment of the licensee, more than a seven-day supply of an opioid is necessary for the patient's acute medical condition, chronic pain management, pain associated with cancer, or pain experienced while the patient is in palliative care

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: require that a licensee who has a federal Drug Enforcement Administration registration number register with the controlled substance prescription database under AS 17.30.200(n)

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Physicians may prescribe controlled substances through telehealth if they comply with state and federal law governing prescription, dispensing, or administering of controlled substances. Telehealth allowed for ongoing treatment/follow-up care with established physician-patient relationship and prior in-person visit, or for life-threatening conditions with proper referral documentation
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: A physician, podiatrist, osteopath, or physician assistant licensed under AS 08.64 may prescribe, dispense, or administer through telehealth under this section a prescription for a controlled substance listed in AS 11.71.140 - 11.71.190 if the physician, podiatrist, osteopath, or physician assistant complies with state and federal law governing the prescription, dispensing, or administering of a controlled substance

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: A person licensed under this chapter shall report in writing to the board concerning the outcome of each medical malpractice claim or civil action in which damages have been or are to be paid by or on behalf of the licensee to the claimant or plaintiff, whether by judgment or under a settlement. This report shall be made within 30 days after resolution of the claim or termination of the civil action

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: A hospital that revokes, suspends, conditions, restricts, or refuses to grant hospital privileges to, or imposes a consultation requirement on, a person licensed to practice medicine or osteopathy in the state shall report to the board the name and address of the person and the reasons for the action within seven working days after the action is taken

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: under regulations adopted by the board, contract with private professional organizations to establish an impaired medical professionals program to identify, confront, evaluate, and treat persons licensed under this chapter who abuse alcohol, other drugs, or other substances or are mentally ill or cognitively impaired

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: For the purposes of an investigation under this chapter, the board may order a person to whom it has issued a license or permit to submit to a medical or psychiatric examination by a physician or other practitioner of the healing arts appointed by the board

locum_tenens_permit_available.quote: A member of the board, its executive secretary, or a person designated by the board to issue temporary permits may grant a temporary permit to a physician or osteopath for the purpose of substituting for another physician or osteopath licensed in this state; being temporarily employed by a physician or osteopath licensed in this state while that physician or osteopath evaluates the permittee for permanent employment; or being temporarily employed by a hospital or community mental health center while the facility attempts to fill a vacant permanent physician or osteopath staff position

investigational_drug_protection.quote: A physician may not be subject to disciplinary action by the board for prescribing, dispensing, or administering an investigational drug, biological product, or device, or providing related treatment, to a patient for the purpose of sustaining the patient's life if the patient has a terminal illness; is ineligible or unable to participate in a current clinical trial for the investigational drug, biological product, or device; has considered, after consultation with the physician, all other treatment options currently approved by the United States Food and Drug Administration; and has given informed consent in writing for the use of the investigational drug, biological product, or device
